verdict_text:
YES

The script maps adapter names (`base_model.model.` + base name) to base names correctly, uses `scale = lora_alpha / r = 2` read from the config, computes `delta = B @ A` as `[6144, 2048]` and skips the transpose because `fan_in_fan_out` is false, accumulates in float32 (`sd[key].float() + scale * delta`, with the float32 adapter factors) and casts back to the original float16 dtype — the RHS is fully evaluated before rebinding, so `sd[key].dtype` is still float16. No adapter or intermediate key is ever inserted into `sd`, so the output key set stays the 244 base names. All four required checks (16 merges, no `lora_` name, `[6144, 2048]` shape, 244 tensors) are asserted before `save_sharded_safetensors` is called, with the shard budget set to 536,870,912 bytes.
